newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INNOGENETICS IN 1.79 MLN BFR CAP INCREASE.
newsitem.headline: INNOGENETICS IN 1.79 MLN BFR CAP INCREASE.

text.p: Belgium-based biotechnology firm Innogenetics NV said it issued 70,649 new ordinary shares on Friday, resulting in a common stock increase of 1.79 million francs to 561.56 million francs.

The Ghent-based company said in a statement that the increase was the result of the exercise of warrants issued by the October 25, 1996 extraordinary shareholders meeting, for the benefit of employees and key consultants.

Easdaq-listed Innogenetics is engaged in research, development and marketing of diagnostic products for the detection of human diseases and in the discovery of development of new therapeutic products.
